qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for cross member to body mounting on the automatic transmission?
What torque value should be used for rubber mounts to cross member or transmission?
What is the torque specification for rubber mounts to carrier pipe on E36 models?
What torque should be applied to the carrier plate on E36 models?
Which transmission mounting components apply to all BMW model types?
qa_pairs.answer: Cross member to body (1AZ) and rubber mounts to cross member or transmission (2AZ)

qa_pairs.question: What section number covers automatic transmission mounting specifications?
What is the highest torque specification listed in the transmission mounts table?
qa_pairs.answer: 42 Nm for support tube to engine subframe on E36 models

qa_pairs.question: How many different torque values are specified for E36 transmission mounting components?
qa_pairs.answer: Two torque values: 42 Nm and 21 Nm
